newsitem.title: USA: Dell unveils network server for $5,349.
newsitem.headline: Dell unveils network server for $5,349.

text.p: Dell Computer Corp said it began shipping a full-featured network server aimed at running a department within a corporate computing enterprise, with a starting price of $5,349.

The server, called the PowerEdge 4200, has a Pentium II processor, running at speeds of 233, 266 or 300 megahertz. Dell introduced another server, the PowerEdge 2200 last month, also designed around the Pentium II, but aimed at workgroups.
Dell said the PowerEdge 4200 is optimized to run network operating systems and groupware products and it is designed for Internet and intranet, database and enterprise functions.
